narrative.overview:
HeartBridge is the category standard for heart-rate apps executed with full finish: a near-black ground, rounded charcoal cards, one red heart, and a number large enough to read from across a dim room, through a VR overlay or in an OBS capture. Everything is native egui, painted in the app's own palette; no control is left in egui's stock grey. The window has no system frame; its own title bar sits on the ground colour so the whole window reads as one surface.

The hierarchy is fixed by the job: the pulse first (drawn heart, Bahnschrift numeral, zone pill, two-minute trace), then whether the strap is connected and VRChat is receiving (status rows with coloured dots), then the two send switches, then the settings, all visible at once in two columns with no scrolling. Density is calm; cards are separated by tone and a hairline, never by shadow. Motion is spent only on the heartbeat and on state changes, and the app redraws only when it has to, because it runs beside VRChat under heavy GPU load.

The same world collapses into three expressions: the full window (800 x 700), the compact window (300 x 150) for overlays and stream, and the tray popup (240 wide, height fitted to its content), plus a 32 px tray icon that carries the live BPM in pixel digits.
keyCharacteristics: Always dark: ground, then card, then pill, in three tonal steps.
One red, used for the heart, the switches when on, the history line and the tray icon.
Numerals in Bahnschrift 700; every other word in Segoe UI Variable, all loaded from C:\Windows\Fonts.
Every glyph is painted in code: heart, caption buttons (including the debug bug), dots, switches, tray digits. No icon font, no image files.
Frugal rendering: 30 fps only while a beat animates, otherwise once a second.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: The accent marks the pulse and an "on" state; apart from the 35% text selection and the tray icon square, it is never a surface behind text, a border or a decoration.

rules.name: The Zone Dot Rule
rules.body: Zone colours appear only on the zone pill's dot; the pill itself stays slate and its text white.

rules.name: The Ash Is Not Text Rule
rules.body: text-dim is too faint for words on card (about 2.6:1); it colours dots only. Placeholders and hints use text-secondary.

rules.name: The Instrument Numeral Rule
rules.body: Bahnschrift is for numbers that are read as measurements (the BPM). Labels, values like "87%" and addresses stay in Segoe UI Variable.

rules.name: The Shared Baseline Rule
rules.body: A unit set beside a numeral shares its baseline; it never centres against the numeral's box.

rules.name: The Tone Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface is raised by one tonal step and a hairline, never by a drop shadow or glow.

dos: **Do** paint every control in the palette: switches, captions, chevron, dots and numeric fields are drawn, not stock egui.
**Do** keep the BPM in Bahnschrift 700 with "bpm" in Fog on the same baseline.
**Do** separate surfaces by tone plus a 1 px hairline (card on ground, pill on card).
**Do** use text-secondary (#9AA0A8) for placeholders, hints and descriptions.
**Do** request a repaint at 33 ms only while a beat animates; otherwise once a second.
**Do** load fonts from C:\Windows\Fonts and fall back to egui's built-ins if missing.
donts: **Don't** add shadows or glows to cards, popups or the window.
**Don't** use zone colours anywhere but the zone pill's dot.
**Don't** set text in text-dim (#5C6169); it is for dots.
**Don't** use the accent as a surface behind text, except the tray icon's digit square.
**Don't** introduce a light theme; the app is always dark.
**Don't** use icon fonts or bitmap assets for UI glyphs.
